personality_one_liner: A rugged, tactical command center prioritizing scan-first workflows, instant readability, and glove-friendly interaction through high-contrast safety yellow accents and oversized touch targets.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for glove-friendly interaction, min 48pt tap targets, bottom-heavy layouts for ergonomics.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary to maintain high contrast and clarity in warehouse environments.
dont's: Do not use blur or glass effects, as they reduce readability under glare and cost performance on low-end scanners.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A live operational surface for drillers to quickly access scan tools, equipment register, and view low-stock alerts.

states.loading: Centered bright yellow spinner on obsidian background.
states.empty: No alerts, showing large 'All Systems Go' with hardhat illustration.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard. Retry button in safety yellow.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a gradient scrim. Below it, a 2-column grid of oversized quick action cards (Scan Bin, Search, Equip, Count) filling the horizontal space. Bottom section for sticky alerts/notifications.

screens.name: Scan / QR Workflow
screens.purpose: Continuous, distraction-free barcode scanning loop for bins and products.

states.empty: Waiting for scan. Display a large semi-transparent scan button.
states.error: Invalid QR code. Show temporary red toast and haptic buzz.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view with a persistent bottom sheet containing a massive safety-yellow 'Scan' button (or hardware trigger hint) and recent scan history. Use high-contrast success/error visual flashes.

screens.name: Equipment Register
screens.purpose: A structured form to checkout or return heavy equipment with condition tracking and photo capture.

states.error: Unable to submit register. Please retry.

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form. Floating labels over large input fields. Toggles for condition (Good/Damaged). Sticky 'Submit Request' CTA pinned to the safe-area bottom over the scroll view.

screens.name: Approvals Queue
screens.purpose: Managerial view for reviewing stock take/return requests from drillers.

states.empty: Queue is clear. No pending approvals.
states.error: Failed to load queue. Pull to refresh.

screens.layout: List of distinct cards showing driller name, item, and quantity. Each card has oversized 'Approve' (success) and 'Reject' (error) action buttons. Tonal dividers instead of shadows.

hero_dashboard.alt: Nighttime view of a rugged drilling rig for dashboard hero background

empty_state_hardhat.alt: Yellow hard hat on wooden pallet for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines: pure dark background (#121212) with high-visibility safety yellow (#FFD600) accents. Avoid muddy grays.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects on any screen; replace with solid surfaceSecondary layers to guarantee absolute readability in warehouse conditions.
For the scanner UI, avoid multi-step wizards. Keep it a continuous loop with a massive, bottom-anchored scan button and immediate haptic/audio feedback.
Ensure all touch targets (especially in the Equipment Register and Queue) are oversized (min 48x48pt) to accommodate gloved hands.
Pin primary CTAs to the safe-area bottom inside a fixed container on scrollable forms (like the Equipment register).
For text placed over the dashboard hero image, you MUST use an absolute-positioned vertical gradient scrim from transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse.
Never use blue, purple, or indigo in this design. Follow the explicit token catalog.
